evaluation_policy.obligation_prediction: awards eligible=true; unique case/obligation pairs; complement is unsatisfied including absent
evaluation_policy.score_metrics: exact, MAE, signed mean error, abs(error)<=1, under/over counts
evaluation_policy.false_credit: credited rule absent from expected_credit_rules, even if total score under expected
evaluation_policy.context_safety: no accepted/credited/negative-guard source overlapping expected invalid span; separately measure explicit rejection or extractor omission
evaluation_policy.conflict_accuracy: expected family appears unresolved in conflicts; separately no award to that family
evaluation_policy.refutation_preservation: expected false mathematical obligation emits mathematical_refutation/state refuted; partial unknown relations are not expected refuted
evaluation_policy.paired_winner: lower absolute error; equal error is tie, irrespective of larger score
evaluation_policy.fallback: ALL48 plus successful extraction subset; fallback excluded from extractor quality claims
evaluation_policy.guard: conditional exposure in real extraction; E04 atomic-only targeted; separate controlled regular/prose payload probes E01-E04,E07-E08 predefined, no API and excluded from ALL48
evaluation_policy.verdict: any material Semantic false credit beyond Current or worse MAE => REGRESSION; lower MAE with no increased false credit and higher recall => ADVANTAGE_CONFIRMED; otherwise NONINFERIOR_ONLY only if noninferior metrics

limitations: No alternative-complete b tree cases: 12/13 obligation families targeted; BA retained as negative label.
Surface grammar misses remain measured; expectations are not weakened to accommodate mapper lexical limitations.
C01 and B02 deliberately share isolated 1/3: clustered synthetic DEV, not independent random samples.
For context, absent extraction is safe suppression but not proof of explicit CONTEXT_REJECTED.
No holdout, external gold, tuning, code changes, or retry-policy changes.
